note: Gold scores agreed by the harness authors for calibration; synthetic, original scripts written for this set. Tolerance: mean absolute error <= 0.6 per criterion and <= 0.4 on the weighted score. Pace measured as spoken words (bracketed visual and source notes excluded) / 30 s: cal-01 3.3, cal-02 3.17, cal-03 2.77, cal-04 2.6, cal-05 2.33 words per second.

changelog.change: accuracy gold: cal-01 1->2, cal-03 4->3, cal-04 5->4, cal-05 5->4
changelog.reason: First calibration run: all 3 blind judges agreed and cited the anchor text. cal-04/05 leave "around pH 3.9" unsourced, so anchor 5 ("every factual claim flagged") is not met; cal-03 states the 3,000-year hook as fact with no flag; cal-01 has no source but no claim is clearly wrong, so it sits between anchors 1 and 3. The gold, not the panel, broke the rubric.
changelog.guard: A corrected gold is confirmed by a fresh panel on the next release; if that panel disagrees, the anchor wording is rewritten instead of moving gold again.
